summary: Register-only Bruce lookout at 48.767 N, 123.506 W, elevation 704 with no unit printed; read as metres, the height fits Bruce Peak on Salt Spring Island, but no history or site status was found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikipedia gives Bruce Peak as just over 700 m in one passage and as 709 m in another. The register gives 704 with no unit printed; read as metres, it falls between the two Wikipedia figures. The story gives the register figure and the Wikipedia range.

notes_for_editor: The link between the register's Bruce and Bruce Peak on Salt Spring Island is an inference from the name and the height. No source read gives the peak's coordinates, and the register does not name the peak. The brief has no local_unit for this tower; the register's Greater Vancouver heading conflicts with the Capital Regional District placement in Wikipedia, so no correction is proposed. A second register page, Mount Bruce (same Greater Vancouver heading, no coordinates or height), is in the local cache and may be the same tower; worth checking before merging. A Facebook group post in search results (BC Forest Fire Lookouts) says a Mount Bruce Forest Lookout was in operation on Salt Spring Island in 1940. The post body was not readable (fetch returned only its title), so it is not used. The Salt Spring Island Archives, which appeared in search and was not read, may hold the 1940 record.
